material_findings.title: HI Cyber Con 2026 CTF: Agentic AI division and 2500 USD cash pool
material_findings.eligibility: official organizer says worldwide and teams of 1-5; participant registration not independently established
material_findings.scope: Only organizer-issued challenges on official competition platform and only under live event rules; Agentic AI division permits AI-assisted solving, but infrastructure/rate-limit/fair-play rules still apply
